audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats the blind as a total answer to Silver Bolts: spikes[0].text "Blinding Shot erases Silver Bolts stacking entirely — Vayne cannot proc W through a blind", whys[0] "cannot proc W through Blinding Shot", whys[2] "your Q deletes her W proc every time she tries".
audit.why: Silver Bolts procs on "The third consecutive attack OR ABILITY against the same target". Condemn is an ability and counts toward the stack, so a blinded Vayne still has a route to the third hit. The blind denies the stacks her autos would have added, which is strong, but "erases Silver Bolts stacking entirely" overstates it in the exact situation that kills Teemo — blind, then Condemn into a wall.
audit.corrected: A blinded auto adds no stack, but Condemn counts toward the third hit — the blind denies her autos, not the proc itself.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (W Silver Bolts: "third consecutive attack or ability", E Condemn)

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and mid claims "With Q at max rank the blind lasts long enough to eat a full Silver Bolts auto-sequence".
audit.why: Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and is an auto-attack reset, against Blinding Dart's flat 7s at every rank. Even at rank 1 she recovers a reset auto before your blind is back, and by max rank Tumble is 2s to your 7s — with Final Hour cutting it further. This ratio, not her item scaling alone, is the mechanical reason the matchup inverts, and it is the number the entry most needed.
audit.corrected: Tumble 6s at rank 1 falling to 2s, an auto-reset, against your flat 7s blind.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (Q Tumble 6/5/4/3/2, flags autoReset; R Final Hour)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] is labelled "Lvl 4-5" but says "your shrooms cover tribush and river entrances"; mid says "Levels 4-5 ... your mushrooms now cover tribush, river entrances"; whys[3] says "mushrooms on every Tumble angle make Levels 4-5 a trap maze".
audit.why: Noxious Trap is the ultimate — no mushrooms exist before level 6. All three fields build the levels 4-5 plan on an ability the player does not have, and levels 4-5 is precisely the window where the Tumble-versus-blind cooldown ratio should be driving the advice instead.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are spacing only; mushrooms start at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Q is max-ranked" (spikes[1].text), "Q at max rank" (mid, whys[3]) at levels 4-5.
audit.why: Teemo cannot have Q at rank 5 by level 5, and it would not matter if he could: Blinding Dart's cooldown is a flat 7s at every rank, so extra ranks buy blind duration only and never tighten the loop these fields are describing.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart is 7s flat at all ranks.

audit.why: The Condemn-into-wall thread is right and well handled — wants.foe[0], wants.you[1] and early's "Never stand near walls even this early" all correctly identify that Condemn only stuns on terrain collision and that it is her one kill threat. mid's point that mushrooms stay hidden until she is on them, so Final Hour invisibility does not save her from a trap she never saw, is also sound.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Blinding Shot" in spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], whys[0]; "Liandry's Angueur" in spikes[2].text.
audit.why: Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. "Liandry's Angueur" is not a real item; the full layer writes Liandry's Torment.

edits.before: Vayne top is your dream matchup early — she has no gap-close, no hard CC outside Condemn, and Silver Bolts requires three autos to proc, every one of which you can blind. At level 1, open with an auto to proc Toxic Shot poison before she can stack anything, then immediately Q-blind when she retaliates. She cannot proc W through the blind, so you get poison ticking while she wastes the stack. At level 2 you compound this with Move Quick: poke, Q when she follows up, and W out before she can angle a Condemn. Never stand near walls even this early — Condemn is her only kill threat and she will burn it the moment you give her an angle.
edits.after: Vayne top is your dream matchup early — she has no gap-close, no hard CC outside Condemn, and Silver Bolts needs three hits to proc, most of which you can blind. At level 1, open with an auto to proc Toxic Shot poison before she can stack anything, then immediately Q-blind when she retaliates. A blinded auto adds no Silver Bolts stack, so you get poison ticking while she wastes the swing — but Condemn counts toward the third hit too, so she can still close a stack with E. At level 2 you compound this with Move Quick: poke, Q when she follows up, and W out before she can angle a Condemn. Never stand near walls even this early — Condemn is her only kill threat.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your strongest window. With Q at max rank the blind lasts long enough to eat a full Silver Bolts auto-sequence, and your mushrooms now cover tribush, river entrances, and the lane brushes she would use to angle a Condemn. Force trades by AA-ing in, Q-blinding her response, and walking out while poison ticks — she cannot reliably Tumble out of the poison radius without stepping on a shroom, and if she does she is slowed and revealed. At 6 plant mushrooms in every Tumble corridor on her side of lane: the invisible movement from Final Hour does not let her avoid traps she cannot see, so she will proc one the moment she engages. Force the all-in here, not later.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your strongest window, but you have no mushrooms yet — Noxious Trap arrives at 6. Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank while Tumble is 6s at rank 1, so she gets her reset auto back before your blind does: force trades by AA-ing in, Q-blinding her response, and walking out while poison ticks rather than extending. At 6, plant mushrooms in every Tumble corridor on her side of lane and on the brushes she would use to angle a Condemn — traps stay hidden until she is on top of them, so the Final Hour invisibility does nothing to help her avoid a shroom she never saw. Force the all-in here, not later.

edits.before: Vayne auto-attacks to stack Silver Bolts but cannot proc W through Blinding Shot — she loses the very mechanic her kit is built around at level 1, so you set the poke tone immediately.
edits.after: Vayne auto-attacks to stack Silver Bolts and a blinded auto adds no stack — Blinding Dart takes the mechanic her kit is built around, though Condemn can still close a stack for her.

edits.before: Q at max rank and mushrooms on every Tumble angle make Levels 4-5 a trap maze she cannot navigate safely — she is either eating poison or stepping on a shroom any time she contests.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 land before mushrooms exist, so this is spacing alone: your flat 7s blind against Tumble's 6s reset means she recovers first — take one-cycle trades, never extended ones.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, wall-stun. Don't get pinned. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1 down to 2s, an auto-reset against your flat 7s blind. - Silver Bolts: abilities stack it too.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — Blind + poke her.
edits.after: Condemn counts toward the Silver Bolts third hit, so a blind alone leaves her a route to it.

notes: The "blind erases Silver Bolts entirely" framing is the dangerous one here — it is true for her autos and false for Condemn, and the failure case (blind, then Condemn into a wall for the third stack) is exactly the sequence that kills Teemo. The no-mushrooms-before-6 error appears here for the fourth time in this slice (Sylas, Tahm Kench, Urgot, Vayne), which makes it look like a generator-level fault rather than nine independent mistakes.
